shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!*node_modules*'"' | sed -n '1,160p' && find node_modules/next/dist/docs -maxdepth 3 -type f | sed -n '1,120p'"

/bin/bash -lc 'rg -l "''^# (cookies|headers)|cookies'"\\(\\)|headers\\(\\)\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app | sed -n '1,120p'
printf '\\n--- package.json ---\\n'
sed -n '1,220p' package.json
printf '\\n--- app/page.tsx ---\\n'
sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx
printf '\\n--- app/layout.tsx ---\\n'
sed -n '1,240p' app/layout.tsx
printf '\\n--- tsconfig.json ---\\n'
sed -n '1,240p' tsconfig.json
printf '\\n--- instructions ---\\n'
for f in AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md GEMINI.md; do printf '\\n[%s]\\n' \""'$f"; sed -n '"'1,240p' \""'$f"; done'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,280p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/cookies.md
printf '\\n--- HEADERS DOC ---\\n'
sed -n '1,280p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/headers.md
printf '\\n--- SERVER COMPONENT DOC ---\\n'
sed -n '1,300p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/05-server-and-client-components.md"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short
printf '\\n--- next.config.ts ---\\n'
sed -n '1,220p' next.config.ts
printf '\\n--- Next version ---\\n'
node -p \"require('./node_modules/next/package.json').version\""

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short
git diff -- app/page.tsx tsconfig.json
sed -n '1,220p' tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3100/ | rg -o 'Current theme:<"'!-- -->[''^<]+|Preferred language:<!-- -->[''^<]+'"' && curl -fsS -H 'Cookie: theme=dark' -H 'Accept-Language: fr-CA,fr;q=0.9' http://127.0.0.1:3100/ | rg -o 'Current theme:<"'!-- -->[''^<]+|Preferred language:<!-- -->[''^<]+'"'"
/bin/bash -lc "curl -fsS -H 'Cookie: theme=dark' -H 'Accept-Language: fr-CA,fr;q=0.9' http://127.0.0.1:3100/ | sed 's/></>\\n</g' | rg 'Current theme|Preferred language'"

/bin/bash -lc 'test ! -e /tmp/codex-workspace-next-build && mv -- .next /tmp/codex-workspace-next-build
git diff --check
git status --short
git diff -- app/page.tsx tsconfig.json'
